_comment: Configuration for the instruction-dataset-builder pipeline. Copy to config.json and edit.
_subjects_comment: Default subject label for documents that match no prefix in subject_map.
_subject_map_comment: Map path prefixes to subject labels. Longest/most specific prefix wins by order.
_auto_subject_comment: Infer a subject label from document content when no subject_map prefix matches.

qa._max_per_answer_comment: How many questions may share one answer. 2 doubles the rows but creates near-duplicate questions (same atom, different template) - validate.py will flag them.

llm._comment: Optional: rewrites only the QUESTION, answer stays verbatim from source.
